entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit customer support. You're speaking with Alex. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help with that. Could I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
Sarah Jenkins. The order number is VF8675309.
Thank you, Sarah. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloFit Aero cycling shoes. What specifically is the issue with them?
They give me blisters. They're useless.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I know how frustrating that can be. Just to be thorough, was it a sizing issue, or did you have any trouble setting up the cleats?
The cleats are fine. The shoes are not. I just want a refund.

I understand completely. Let me just check the policy against your delivery date. I see here they were delivered 72 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window, so I can absolutely process that for you.
Oh. I was expecting a fight. So you're actually going to approve it?

Yes, of course. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. You can just box up the cycling shoes, attach the label, and drop it at any post office.
Once our warehouse receives the item, the full refund will be processed back to your original form of payment. It usually takes 3-5 business days after we receive it.
Whatever. Just as long as it gets done.
It will be. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Sarah?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. I hope you have a better rest of your day.
